build_vocab_from_counter: create a Vocab object from a Counter with max_size and min_freq filters
build_vocab_from_iterator: build a Vocab from an iterator that yields lists of tokens
lookup_token_indices: lookup the numerical indices for a list of token strings using Vocab
extend_vocab: extend an existing Vocab with tokens from another Vocab instance
load_pretrained_vectors: load pretrained word vectors like GloVe or FastText into a Vocab
